answer: To stop fake bots on the zephyr grid, every account locks a refundable stake bond and answers paired 64 KB spot-check audits mixed into verified daily tasks. An opal scheduler rewrites earlier questions in new words and burns the deposit whenever scripted templates return conflicting replies. An operator running 100 fakes must post 100x the bond and track 100 coherent work logs, losing more stake on audit failure than any 1x reward it could earn. One honest agent runs one kernel check once per 6 hours. This fails if insiders leak the audit pairs.
